rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency value U_USD as not USD, but raw Schedule of Investments rows use dollar-denominated amortized cost and fair value columns. Representative flagged rows show dollar signs in the par amount, amortized cost, and fair value columns; rows without repeated dollar signs are continuation rows under the same USD-denominated table header. The source supports USD denomination, so the defect is in the rule/unit-label normalization rather than the extracted holding data.
